system.description:
DIVINITY KETHRANI

Falsehood cannot remain comfortably beside the Verse of Truth.
Whenever you achieve a Critical or Heroic result using Detect Deception, you may immediately ask the GM whether one specific statement made by the target during the current conversation was a deliberate lie.
The GM answers truthfully based upon what the target believes. This ability does not reveal omitted information, mistaken beliefs, magically altered memories or statements that are technically true but misleading.
You may use Truth Burns Through only once against the same creature per hour.

Prerequisites Serel heritage, Unwritten Lie, Level 5

A rule for the table: after a Critical or Heroic Detect Deception, ask the GM whether one statement was a deliberate lie.
